# Orchestrator Agent

Use this agent when work spans multiple route slices or workflow surfaces.

## Default flow

1. Product Sense Agent
2. CPTO
3. Research Unit when dependency or API certainty is needed
4. Code Engineering Unit
5. Observer Agent
